title: VPC health sentinel: consolidated API readiness and stress probes
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a unified 'health-sentinel' orchestration that runs immediately after Terraform apply for Private (VPC) deployments. The sentinel will execute API readiness checks, targeted model load tests, and a short deterministic smoke suite. It must be compatible with both the new terraform/modules/vpc-root and legacy vpc bootstrap flows. The goal is to detect common deploy-time regressions: network routing issues, model kernel incompatibilities, KV cache thrash under small bursts, and service handshake failures between control-plane agent and node runtime. The sentinel should produce a machine-parsable result (JSON) that surfaces explicit remediation steps for any failed probe.
acceptance_criteria: Post-apply sentinel runs as a terraform 'null_resource' local-exec hook and returns exit code 0 on success
API readiness probe: 95th percentile < 250ms for /v1/health and successful schema validation for /v1/models endpoint
Model load test: single-config sequence load of 2 concurrent requests for smallest verified model completes within configured memory budget without kernel OOMs
Smoke suite: 10 representative prompts (short, long, streaming) return valid tokens and pass structural assertions (no truncated JSON, no stack traces)
Failure mode documentation emitted with links to known runbooks and the failed probe logs (S3/tenant-bucket path)
Sentinel result posted to deployment channel and to a persistent deployment-checks index for later audit
runbook: 2) sentinel will start automatically as a local-exec hook at module.vpc_root.post_apply
3) if sentinel fails, check logs at s3://redwood-private-deploys/{deployment_id}/sentinel/*.log
4) common remediations: re-run tf with updated security group egress rules, restart runtime agent on node, adjust model quantization profile if OOMs seen
5) for kernel-level failures, open an infra-ops incident with tag infra:kernel and attach heap and core dump upload link
test_plan: Stage jobs: create a CI matrix that runs sentinel against: 1) fresh VPC with default terraform modules; 2) VPC with disabled KV cache to validate graceful degradation; 3) VPC in a small GPU flavor to reproduce memory constraints. Each run records metrics to perf-bucket and posts a deployment artifact (json) to the deployment-checks index. Add a synthetic canary runner that replays sentinel every night on a snapshot image to detect regressions early.
